title: Xor Queries
statement: An initially empty integer array supports five interleaved operations: appending a value at the end, deleting the last k values, and three queries over a contiguous index range, namely reporting the stored value that maximizes its xor with a given x, counting values at most x, and returning the k-th smallest. Up to 500000 operations arrive, each value at most 500000, and every query must be answered.
